QuestInfo.name: [Ren] Trip Into the Ship
QuestInfo.0: Go inside the ship and look for clues.
QuestInfo.1:
Go inside the ship and look for clues.
The Flora ship is anchored in the middle of Vallora.
Wear the High Flora soldier hat the guild master gave you to get inside.
QuestInfo.2: You received a job to investigate a High Flora ship and find the citizen they kidnapped. Inside, you found paperwork that may prove useful.
